programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: TARDIS lander vist på et normalt hotel. Men værelserne skjuler gæsternes dybeste og mest dystre frygt.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Doktorens liv er ved at rinde ud, og han løber ind i et mysterium, da han besøger en gammel ven.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Doktoren er på sin sidste rejse til Lake Silencios bredder i Utah.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Doktoren er blevet bortført af sin værste fjende, og han tvinges på en umulig mission.

programme.title: Doctor Who

programme.title: The Monster Squad

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser
programme.desc: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programme.desc: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return

programme.title: South Park: Splattet tomat
programme.desc: Børnene i South Park påstår, at de har set mr. Garrison luske omkring. Indbyggerne er vrede over, at præsidenten skræmmer deres børn.

programme.title: South Park: Scooterne
programme.desc: Børnene vil bruge det seneste i transportmidler for at få mere slik til Halloween end nogensinde før.

programme.title: South Park: Tegridy Farms Halloween Special
programme.desc: Det er halloween og Randy skal forholde sig til datterens marihuanaproblem.

programme.title: South Park: Øjenbetændelse
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny bliver slået ihjel af en nedfaldende rumstation og bliver forvandlet til en zombie af noget balsamerende væske, der er forurenet med engelsk sovs.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største nar
programme.desc: Da et berømt spititistik medium ikke kan mane Kenny ud af Cartmans krop, forsøger Chefs mor lidt voodoomagi på ham selv.

programme.title: South Park: Helvede på jord 2006
programme.desc: Det er halloween og Satan arrangerer verdens største kostymebal.

programme.title: South Park: De levende hjemløses nat

programme.title: South Park: Den ustuearrest-bare
programme.desc: Led og ked af hvordan han bliver behandlet af sine forældre, tager den altid uskyldige Butters den nye vampyr-galskab til sig, lidt for entusiastisk.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Chili Shop / Massage Parlor

programme.title: Nathan For You: Shipping Logistics Company

programme.title: The Scarlet Claw
programme.desc: When a gentlewoman is found dead with her throat torn out, the villagers blame a supernatural monster. But Sherlock Holmes, who gets drawn into the case from nearby Quebec, suspects a human murderer.

programme.title: The Woman in Green

programme.title: Pursuit to Algiers

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 2

programme.title: Top Gear

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 1

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: En død krop, der anvendes til et forsøg med sporingsudstyr, forsvinder fra lighuset og NCIS-enheden bliver tilkaldt.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: En hjemmeside får fat i en række fortrolige dokumenter, men NCIS-enheden må først finde personen bag tyveriet, før de er i stand til at dekryptere koden.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Sam må gå undercover i et statsfængsel for at kunne hjælpe NCIS med at opspore en terroristgruppe, som er ansvarlig for adskillige internationale bombeattentater.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en indbrudstyv på færsk gerning, opdager Callen en organisation, der producerer falske computerchips. En tidigere KGB-agent hjælper teamet.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Callen og Sam går undercover som CHP-officerer for at afsløre ulovlig salg af militært udstyr og både politibetjente og militært personale indgår i aktionen.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Further immersing themselves into Harlan county, the team investigates an active coal mine, Portal 31, and speaks with its manager about his own paranormal claims both inside the mine and in Lynch, Kentucky.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Harlan County Courthouse was both sanctuary and execution site. The town hub that witnessed a brutal revenge killing and countless trials of corrupt lawmen is the site of the country's most haunted building.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The screams of Cassius Clay in his final days can still be heard reverberating through the walls of White Hall. Caretakers have had their belief in the supernatural shifted ever since they began spending time at the site.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Morgan Fairchild, Lili Taylor, John Salley, Vincent Curatola
programme.desc: A young Morgan Fairchild is abused by a spirit when she moves into her new husband's family home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Michael Imperioli, Joan Collins, Donna D'Errico, Corey Feldman
programme.desc: Michael Imperioli meets a tormented spirit at a legendary New York hotel; & more.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Season three of "From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series" continues the Gecko brothers' saga as they fight their way through the chilling world of culebras, the vampire-snake hybrids that control hidden empires in Texas and Mexico.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: A pit stop at a liquor store leads to a deadly standoff for bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko, who are making a run for the Mexican border.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie's visions intensify as the Gecko Brothers escape the liquor store with dogged lawman Freddie Gonzalez in close pursuit.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Brødrene Gecko er mordere på flugt fra Texas. På vej mod Mexico, tager de familien Fuller som gidsler. Kaos opstår, da de søger tilflugt i en afsidesliggende stripklub, der viser sig at være fuld af vampyrer. Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Jack beder personalet om at evaluere hans arbejde anonymt, men det giver bagslag. Nina bliver grundet en skade afhængig af Maya.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Rivaliseringen mellem Jack og en anden udgiver skaber en romance mellem Finch og hans modpart på det konkurrerende magasin.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mens Finch forsøger at forføre en model, som han har tilbedt siden barndommen, fortryder Nina, at hun nogensinde har opmuntret et venskab mellem Simon og Jack.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Efter at have glemt et vigtigt møde, udgiver Finch sig for at være Jack for at få en stor aftale i hus.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Vicki overvejer at vende tilbage til sit gamle job som frisør. Nina tager en drag queen under sin vinge, mens Elliott hyrer Finch til at hjælpe ham med at jonglere med et par kærester.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Finch og Elliot bliver rivaler på grund af en fælles mandlig ven, som de begge har en følelsesmæssig forbindelse til. Ninas døde veninde Binnie dukker op i hendes drømme.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Ved deres highschool-genforening konkurrerer Finch og hans barndomsven over en pige, som de begge plejede at idolisere. Maya og Elliott beslutter sig for at blive venner med fordele.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Da Simon frier til Nina, bliver hun nødt til at afsløre, at hun allerede er gift. Jack finder den perfekte fyr til Maya, men hun bliver forelsket i en anden.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mens Maya overbeviser Finchs kæreste om at kræve et mere emotionelt meningsfyldt forhold, konkurrerer Nina og Jack om rengøringspersonalets opmærksomhed på kontoret.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Alt imens Nina opdager en foruroligende sandhed om Simons ultrakonservative forældre, opdager Elliott, at det ikke er helt let at være Jacks nabo.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: An astronaut who was missing for 20 years contacts Earth from an alien planet. However, mere minutes have passed for him, and the wormhole that brought him there is unstable. What are the risks of a rescue operation?

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: A man walking through a snow storm suddenly finds himself at a refuge. They tell him that the entire world is covered in ice. Just as he begins to fall in love with someone, the people's personalities suddenly change. What's happening?

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: A town gets possessed after a dinosaur skeleton that hides ancient parasites that affect the brain and cause madness is unearthed. The only hope is an immune mentally challenged boy who must learn how to destroy them.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: While expecting a shipment of missiles, the militia receive a sealed cargo and messenger refusing to reveal what the deadly cargo is. Shortly afterward, an alien life-form begins a series of chilling attacks.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Callen og Sam går undercover som CHP-officerer for at afsløre ulovlig salg af militært udstyr og både politibetjente og militært personale indgår i aktionen.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Deeks bliver skudt i en butik og NCIS-enheden undersøger, om motivet bag overfaldet var at røve butikken eller om nogen har til hensigt at få ram på Deeks.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Enheden bliver bedt om at redde sønnen til en prins og fange lederen af en terroristgruppe. Nate genforenes med sit team i Yemen for at give dem en hjælpende hånd.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: NCIS undersøger, om en venezuelansk politiker er i fare for at blive myrdet, men må for at få svaret først finde den efterretningsofficer, der netop er meldt savnet.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Da det opdages, at nogen har brudt sig ind i et beskyttet rum på en marinebase, må NCIS-enheden finde ud af, hvad målet med tyveriet har været. Kensi går undercover for at løse sagen.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Da en ekspert i raketmotorer findes død i et prøvekammer, går Eric for første gang undercover for at sikre, at den hemmelige raketteknologi forbliver fortrolig.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Michael Imperioli, Joan Collins, Donna D'Errico, Corey Feldman
programme.desc: Michael Imperioli meets a tormented spirit at a legendary New York hotel; & more.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tracey Gold, Alice Cooper, Fred Dryer, Katherine Erbe
programme.desc: The spirit of a lonely child seeks refuge with Tracey Gold; and more.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Billy Baldwin, Tempestt Bledsoe, Tracy Nelson, Eric Balfour
programme.desc: A stay at a desolate hotel confirms Billy Baldwin's belief in the other side.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Anthony Michael Hall
programme.desc: Actor Anthony Michael Hall (The Breakfast Club, Sixteen Candles, The Dead Zone) seeks the help of medium Kim Russo.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Orlando Jones
programme.desc: Comedian and actor, Orlando Jones (Sleepy Hollow) revisits the North Carolina hotel where he had a paranormal experience so frightening that it forced him to flee in the middle of the night.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Alt imens Nina opdager en foruroligende sandhed om Simons ultrakonservative forældre, opdager Elliott, at det ikke er helt let at være Jacks nabo.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Den godhjertede Elliott diskuterer forretningsstrategier med sin svindler af en bror, Donnie.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mens Finch forsøger at holde sin far i arbejde ved at få ham ansat som Jacks nye chauffør, erhverver Elliott en aldrende onkels hjælp til at hævne sig på en led komiker.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mens Elliott forsøger at overbevise sin tidligere sognepræst om, at han stadig er en god katolik, kæmper Maya for at undgå en irriterende midaldrende praktikants opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Ninas bryllupsdag nærmer sig, men hendes planer begynder at gå i vasken, da præsten viser sig at være en af Simons tidligere groupies.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Jack overrasker alle ved at annoncere at han skal gå på pension.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Journalisten Maya har brug for penge og tvinges til at tage et job på et modemagasin, der ejes af hendes far.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mayas ideer bliver droppet af hendes far, og hendes kolleger forbereder sig på at få deres ideer afvist også.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Finch bliver irriteret og forlader kontoret, han ender på "The Tonight Show", hvor han fortæller, at han engang faldt ned i en gorillabur i zoo.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Jack og Maya holder en fødselsdagsfest for Nina, da hendes planer bliver aflyst, og Finch og Elliott indgår et væddemål.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: While expecting a shipment of missiles, the militia receive a sealed cargo and messenger refusing to reveal what the deadly cargo is. Shortly afterward, an alien life-form begins a series of chilling attacks.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: In lieu of execution, Linden Stiles submits to a military experiment where he is injected with alien DNA. Fighting to retain his humanity, he finds himself hunted after he escapes using his new found super human strength.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: After Earth is conquered by aliens called the Torkor and humans are programmed to be slaves, the human slave of the Torkor leader Koltok is kidnapped and deprogrammed by rebels.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Dr. Christina Markham's mother is suffering from Alzheimer's disease. When three apparently healthy young women age and die within hours, the Markhams are baffled and frightened. The solution comes after the older patients vanish.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Former POW John Skokes, a chief weapons officer and a glory seeking cadet obsessed with the poem "The Charge of the Light Brigade" try to drop a doomsday weapon on the aliens' homeworld and win the war.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Lina Rafn er fyldt 50 og lægger ikke skjul på, at det kræver en indsats at se ud, som hun gør. Med Kenny Aleksandr taler hun om skønhed, alder, vilde X Factor-looks og om at stå ved den, man er – også når man forandrer sig.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Julie Zangenberg har levet det meste af sit liv i spotlightet. Nu har hun skruet ned for glansbilledet og op for sig selv. Om moderskab, venskabet med Medina, det smadrede blonde hår – og hvorfor hun er klar til både mere skuespil og mere glam.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Vickie Berlin taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at blive sat i bås som ”den sjove”, rollen i Triangle of Sadness, Cannes og Oscar – og om hvorfor man aldrig må holde op med at drømme og sætte nye ting på sin bucketliste.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: South Park: Listen
programme.desc: Drengene stjæler en liste fra pigerne, som rangerer deres udseende fra den kønneste til den grimmeste. Opdagelsen påvirker forskellige drenge på forskellige måder.

programme.title: South Park: Det er jul i Canada
programme.desc: Kyles adoptivbror Ike bringes tilbage til Canada af sine biologiske forældre, da den nye canadiske statsminister bestemmer, at alle adoptivbørn fra Canada skal sendes hjem.

programme.title: South Park: Starvin' Marvin i rummet
programme.desc: Marvin er kommet tilbage! Han og drengene rejser jorden rundt på en mission for at samle mad, skarpt forfulgt af CIA og Sally Struthers.

programme.title: South Park: De smås krimiklub
programme.desc: Drengene starter en krimiklub, der skal opklare lokale forbrydelser, og det lykkes dem at finde en forsvunden dukke.

programme.title: South Park: Taberkant
programme.desc: Drengene er trætte af at spille baseball og udtænker en plan for at tabe den store play-off-kamp. Randy træner hårdt for at blive det største fulde fjols til hver kamp.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Deeks bedste ven og vigtigste kilde til information har brug for beskyttelse efter at have været udsat for dødstrusler. Derek går undercover med et af hans tidligere dæknavne.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nye oplysninger om en stjålen radioaktiv cylinder kommer frem, da en person, der foregiver at være en Navy SEAL kommer ind i billedet.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Callen og resten af NCIS-enheden nægter at acceptere Hettys pludselige opsigelse uden at få en forklaring. De påbegynder deres egen efterforskning for at finde ud af, hvorfor hun forsvandt.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Enheden søger efter Hetty i Rumænien og Callen finder ud af mere om nogle hemmeligheder fra sin fortid.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Efter et cyberattack mod forsvarsafdelingen, arbejder NCIS og NSA sammen for at finde den skyldige. Callen fortsætter med at søge efter informationer om sin egen fortid.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Orlando Jones
programme.desc: Comedian and actor, Orlando Jones (Sleepy Hollow) revisits the North Carolina hotel where he had a paranormal experience so frightening that it forced him to flee in the middle of the night.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Margaret Cho

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Jack og Maya holder en fødselsdagsfest for Nina, da hendes planer bliver aflyst, og Finch og Elliott indgår et væddemål.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Elliott tager et billede af Maya til hendes nye ID-kort og synes, at hun er så lækker, at han har en hed drøm om hende om natten.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya er uvenner med sin far, men slikket, han tager med hjem fra en rejse, er et hit på kontoret.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya beviser, at hun har ret i, at udseende er vigtigere end intelligens.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya udfordrer sin fars autoritet, da hun genansætter en assistent, som han har fyret.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Selv om han er gift med en yngre kvinde, går Jack amok, da Maya flirter med en 60-årig playboy.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Trods advarsler fra Elliott falder Finch for den smukke Nikki Elston, og kollegerne må træde til.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya bliver ked af det, da hendes far giver Elliott og Nina billetter til London for at se en forestilling af Royal Shakespeare Company.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: En Woody Allen-imitator bliver tiltrukket af Maya, efter at hun har skrevet en artikel om ham. Jack mister synet for en dag.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mayas seneste opførsel gør det svært for Jack at få Hannah ind på Mayas gamle skole.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Alle Mayas bestræbelser på at læse og skrive bliver ignoreret, da hendes far giver en stor donation og tager al æren for det.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Former POW John Skokes, a chief weapons officer and a glory seeking cadet obsessed with the poem "The Charge of the Light Brigade" try to drop a doomsday weapon on the aliens' homeworld and win the war.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Fading pop singer Melissa McCammon is about to commit suicide, but, Rachel, an ardent fan from the future, wants to save her. Later, authorities from the future show up wanting Melissa dead in order to restore their time-line.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Rebecca Warfield escapes from her body during a scientific experiment, but, due to the meddling of her assistant, she is now trapped and must find a way to communicate with her associates.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Trevor McPhee wants to celebrate New Year's in style. On his way back from the store with the champagne, he has an accident. When he wakes, he hitches a ride home and finds his wife thinks that he abandoned her - ten years ago.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: When Dr. Jack Henson, an ambitious inventor comes up with a "virtual prison" government officials are interested in its cost efficiency. Rather than life sentences, criminals would only have to spend hours being subjected to harsh treatment.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: The last man on Earth living in an underground bunker has a computerized system takes care of his every need including providing holographic friends and relatives. Eventually the system, a female named Emma, demands to be loved.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Lina Rafn er fyldt 50 og lægger ikke skjul på, at det kræver en indsats at se ud, som hun gør. Med Kenny Aleksandr taler hun om skønhed, alder, vilde X Factor-looks og om at stå ved den, man er – også når man forandrer sig.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Julie Zangenberg har levet det meste af sit liv i spotlightet. Nu har hun skruet ned for glansbilledet og op for sig selv. Om moderskab, venskabet med Medina, det smadrede blonde hår – og hvorfor hun er klar til både mere skuespil og mere glam.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Vickie Berlin taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at blive sat i bås som ”den sjove”, rollen i Triangle of Sadness, Cannes og Oscar – og om hvorfor man aldrig må holde op med at drømme og sætte nye ting på sin bucketliste.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: South Park: Sponsoreret indhold

programme.title: South Park: Jakovasaurs

programme.title: South Park: Buddha-boks

programme.title: South Park: Finansier dig selv
programme.desc: Drengene prøver at finde et godt navn til deres nye startup-firma, og døber det The Washington Redskins.

programme.title: South Park: Brætpiger
programme.desc: Den årlige Stærk Kvinde-konkurrence presser alle til grænsen.

programme.desc: En hel by i Colorado bliver hacket. Gerald og Cartman risikerer at miste alt, da deres internethistorik afsløres.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingeelsker
programme.desc: Da Barbrady tilkalder drengene for at hjælpe med at opklare sagen om den berygtede kyllingeelsker, bliver Cartman begejstret for sin nyfundne 'authoritah'.

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himlen
programme.desc: Da drengene leder efter Kenny i Himlen, undersøger myndighederne om Saddam Hussein muligvis skjuler våben der.

programme.title: South Park: Det fattige barn
programme.desc: Kennys forældre bliver anholdt og han kommer i pleje - så nu er Cartman det fattigste barn på skolen! Og en mystisk, maskeret figur fra fortiden vender tilbage.

programme.title: South Park: Major Boobage
programme.desc: De hysteriske forældre i South Park får endnu en grund til at gå i panik, da 'cheesing' bliver populært blandt ungerne.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle bliver uvenner over en magisk trekant, som dukker op på en arkæologisk udgravning. Trekanten giver magt til at forandre Barbra Streisand til et forfærdeligt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Byens kerne
programme.desc: South Parks bykerne skal opgraderes og Kenny bestemmer sig for, at det er på tide at finde et job.

programme.title: South Park: Vilde med abefonetik
programme.desc: Drengene konkurrerer mod et par unger, der har fået hjemmeundervisning, i South Parks årlige stavekonkurrence.

programme.desc: Ført an af 'Mysterion', arbejder 'Coon' og hans venner med at hjælpe folk i Golfen. Og 'Coon' er ude efter hævn.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Tilbageblik
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbage og denne gang har han venner!

programme.desc: Cartman drømmer, at han har et nærgående møde med et rumvæsen. De andre drenge er overbeviste om, at drømmen var virkelig, og at han har været offer for en anal sondeundersøgelse af et rumvæsen.

programme.title: South Park: Røvburgere
programme.desc: Stan's eksistentielle krise fortsætter, og Cartman går ind i burgerbranchen med en superhemmelig, helt særlig ingrediens.

programme.title: South Park: Kontanter for guld
programme.desc: Stands bedstefar forærer ham en nips fra J&G shopping-kanalen, som han har betalt overpris for. Cartman åbner sin egen shoppingkanal da han indser, hvor godt J&G's taktik fungerer.

programme.desc: Drengene bruger spillet Minecraft til at forhindre sine forældre I at skade hinanden.

programme.desc: Mod bedre vidende får Stan en profil på Facebook og bliver en socialt netværkende 'juggernaut', som bevirker, at han bliver suget ind i websitet.

programme.title: South Park: Alt om mormonerne?
programme.desc: En ny dreng, Gary, ankommer til South Park, og hans familie er mormoner. Eric bliver gode venner med ham, men bliver desillusioneret over mormoneres historie.

programme.title: South Park: Den uhyggelige fisk
programme.desc: Sharon Marshs tante Flo har gaver med til Shelly og Stan. Shelly får et fantastisk stereoanlæg, men Stans gave er en fisk; der er bare det ved det, at der er noget uhyggeligt over den fisk.

programme.title: South Park: Overlogging
programme.desc: Der opstår forvirring og panik, da South Park opdager, at internettet er forsvundet!

programme.desc: Da Stan får en Tween Wave CD i fødselsdagsgave forbyder hans forældre at lytte til sådan noget 'lort'. Stan kan kun være enige med dem, hvilket ikke ligefrem imponerer hans venner.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Da drengene rejser til Aspen for at stå på ski for første gang, lægger Stan sig ud med en af de lokale og bliver udfordret til et løb.

programme.title: South Park: Go Gud Go XII!
programme.desc: Cartman nedfryser sig selv og vågner op 500 år ud i fremtiden.

programme.title: South Park: 1%

programme.title: South Park: Fattig og dum
programme.desc: Cartmans nye ambition her i livet er at blive en NASCAR-kører. Kan Cartman vinde sit livs racerløb?

programme.title: South Park: Cherokee hårtamponer
programme.desc: Kyle har brug for en nyretransplantation, og Cartman er den perfekte donor. Men Cartman sætter en høj pris på sin nyre: 10 millioner dollars.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Da det går op for Cartmans mor, at hun ikke længere kan kontrollere sin søn, får hun hjælp fra en ekspert. Cesar Millan, 'Hundehviskeren' tager udfordringen op.

programme.title: South Park: Vægtøgning 4000
programme.desc: Cartman vinder en essaykonkurrence i skolen ved at snyde. I mellemtiden planlægger Mr. Garrison at dræbe Kathy Lee Gifford, som skal overrække præmien.

programme.title: South Park: Tøsen
programme.desc: Ifølge Eric Cartman er Wendy Testaburger blevet lesbisk.

programme.title: South Park: Fedelejr
programme.desc: Mrs. Cartman vil gøre noget for afhjælpe sin søns spiseproblem og sender ham på en lejr for fede børn.

programme.title: South Park: Buddha-boks
programme.desc: Cartman har fået stillet diagnosen angst.

programme.title: South Park: Butters' helt eget afsnit
programme.desc: Butter er tilbage med sin helt egen episode! Uforvarende kommer han til at afsløre en mørk familiehemmelighed om sin fars sene 'natteindkøbsture'.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om, at pigerne har et apparat, som kan se ind i fremtiden, så Butters klæder sig ud som pige for at infiltrere dem.

programme.title: South Park: Tilbage til rødderne
programme.desc: Butters begynder en rejse, der skal følge i sporene på hans hawaiianske forfædre.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos
programme.desc: Drengene fyrer Butters som deres ven, og vækker hans mørke side.

programme.title: South Park: Rosiner

programme.title: South Park: City Sushi
programme.desc: Da Butters bliver indfanget i en asiatisk territoriestrid opdager hans forældre, at han har flere personligheder, og beslutter sig for, at løsningen er at medicinere ham.

programme.title: South Park: Margaritaville
programme.desc: Med inspiration i historien om Kristus, bønfalder Randy byen om at stoppe med impulskøb, men en ung jøde, Kyle, udfordrer sin ortodokse lære.

programme.title: South Park: Vindaloop med stuearrest

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet om de to urinaler

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 1

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Year Of Hell, Part 2
programme.desc: A badly damaged Voyager with a skeleton crew leads an armada of interplanetary ships against them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Telltale Tracks
programme.desc: The disappearance of Philadelphia college athlete Aimee Willard is investigated after her car is found on the roadside. When her body is found, the police find unusual marks and DNA evidence that eventually lead to her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Voice from Beyond
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. But the body had been placed in the barrel 30 years earlier. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Similar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returns home after working the night shift and finds his wife unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their son is fast asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence, but investigators cannot find a conclusive link to their prime suspect. To solve the puzzle, an FBI analyst designs a unique experiment.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeing Red
programme.desc: In 2005, the body of young mother Summer Baldwin was found in a suitcase in a Texas landfill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Accident or Murder

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.desc: An exclusive fertility clinic is much more than it seems. It is run by a cult of female Druids who use a cursed fertility statue to expand their numbers.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Efter et cyberattack mod forsvarsafdelingen, arbejder NCIS og NSA sammen for at finde den skyldige. Callen fortsætter med at søge efter informationer om sin egen fortid.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: En bilbombe sender holdet ud på en mission i hele byen, der har til hensigt at finde de andre stjålne sprængstoffer inden de detoneres. I mellemtiden omorganiserer Hunter enhedens grupper, hvilket skaber stor frustration.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles: Episode 104
programme.desc: NCIS-enheden bliver involveret i den libyske konflikt, da en nyhedsreporter bliver dræbt. Callen finder ud af nogle ting om sin fortid, hvilket kan påvirke forholdet til Hetty.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: NCIS og LAPD bliver tvunget til at arbejde sammen, da en kendt terrorist knyttes til et narkokartel. Sam bliver distraheret, da han opdager, at han har mistet noget vigtigt.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Hetty tager kontakt til sin tidligere kollega, efter at en tidligere officer er blevet dræbt og holdet erfarer, at landets sikkerhed er truet.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Paranormal enthusiasts have theorized that Somerset County’s enthralling paranormal finds may have more to do with the geomagnetic anomalies present in its unique land that yield results which are fascinating to some and terrifying to others.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Long before the first funeral home was established in Manchester, Kentucky in 1938, there was the Chestnut House. The Chestnut family dedicated one of the home’s parlors to store the caskets they made.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Located on the historic site of Perryville Battlefield, it’s believed that the Karrick-Parks House is home to the souls of some 7,600 soldiers who were killed, wounded, or missing in Kentucky’s most destructive Civil War Battle.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Located on the Perryville Battlefield, the site of one of the Civil War’s bloodiest fights, the HP Bottom House has purportedly witnessed countless apparitions and other chilling phenomena.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Alle Mayas bestræbelser på at læse og skrive bliver ignoreret, da hendes far giver en stor donation og tager al æren for det.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya starter en ny trend: i stedet for at give hinanden julegaver, vil de nu give penge til velgørenhed.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Da Elliots yndlingslærer i gymnasiet dør, ser han mindehøjtideligheden som en chance for at hævde sig selv og prale af sit succesfulde liv.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mayas roomie fra college kommer på besøg, hvilket fører til forskellige mærkelige situationer.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya bliver forelsket i en forfatter, som hun også arbejder sammen med, og hun er usikker på, hvordan hun skal opføre sig.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Finch får besøg af sin far, hvilket både overrasker og foruroliger ham.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: På morgenmødet får Jack et uventet vredesudbrud, men nægter at sige, hvad der er galt.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya interviewer den legendariske rockmusiker Nick Hewitt, og Nina afslører, at de havde en affære for 25 år siden.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Karey klarer sig rigtig godt i skolen, og Maya er meget stolt. Nina forsøger på den anden side at overtale Karey til at fortsætte som model i stedet.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Ninas berømte bikini skal udstilles i Model Café, et meget prestigefyldt sted for supermodeller.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: The last man on Earth living in an underground bunker has a computerized system takes care of his every need including providing holographic friends and relatives. Eventually the system, a female named Emma, demands to be loved.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: A mentally impaired janitor, Karl, is befriended by Dr. Valerian, a brilliant scientist who is dying of cancer. The older man decides that his various talents should not be allowed to die with him and convinces the young man to push the green button.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Rebecca Highfield is impregnated by Dr. Lucy Cole with the cells of her dead child, which have been cloned from his brain.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Danny Martin falls in love with Jade, a girl from college. When he brings her home for supper, his father recognizes her as the woman he saved from cruel experiments when he was a private in the army 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: When a virus starts killing people hooked up neurally to a worldwide information network, the only person who can stop it is a man unable to link into it due to a childhood injury.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Vickie Berlin taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at blive sat i bås som ”den sjove”, rollen i Triangle of Sadness, Cannes og Oscar – og om hvorfor man aldrig må holde op med at drømme og sætte nye ting på sin bucketliste.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Lina Rafn er fyldt 50 og lægger ikke skjul på, at det kræver en indsats at se ud, som hun gør. Med Kenny Aleksandr taler hun om skønhed, alder, vilde X Factor-looks og om at stå ved den, man er – også når man forandrer sig.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Julie Zangenberg har levet det meste af sit liv i spotlightet. Nu har hun skruet ned for glansbilledet og op for sig selv. Om moderskab, venskabet med Medina, det smadrede blonde hår – og hvorfor hun er klar til både mere skuespil og mere glam.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Vickie Berlin taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at blive sat i bås som ”den sjove”, rollen i Triangle of Sadness, Cannes og Oscar – og om hvorfor man aldrig må holde op med at drømme og sætte nye ting på sin bucketliste.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: South Park: Fort Collins
